message: Goal: Create a Python script that prints the numbers 1 to 5, each on a new line. Run it and verify.

"numbers.py" "for i in range(1, 6):\n print(i)" file-write "python numbers.py" shell dup "stdout" get print "code" get 0 eq [ "Python script executed successfully" print ] [ "Python script failed to execute" print ] if "Verification complete. Done." done

"numbers.py" "for i in range(1, 6):\n    print(i)" file-write
"python numbers.py" shell
dup "stdout" get print
"code" get 0 eq
[ "Python script executed successfully" print ]
